properties.name: A one-shot `--call` in a folder that names its design on a server never creates a local store; it refuses and names that server
properties.statement:
Step 1 of the plan to make the `--call` door work for an agent that cannot use MCP (Anthony, 2026-10-01).

Today `--call` ignores a `.reflow2.toml` pointer and `--only-if-present`, because both checks run after every one-shot mode has returned. In a folder whose design lives on a server, it therefore creates a fresh empty local design with a new id, and the agent works that, with no error (fact:a-cli-call-in-a-pointer-folder-mints-a-fresh-local-store-2026-10-01).

MUST:
- A one-shot call in such a folder opens nothing and creates nothing.
- It exits non-zero, naming the server address the pointer gives and the route that works there.
- `--only-if-present` is honoured by one-shot modes too.

NOT HERE: forwarding the call to that server, or to a running shared daemon. Those stay open in dec:idea-a-one-shot-call-reaches-the-design-where-it-is-served.
